Passage: When Suleiman the Magnificent died, his heart and body were buried in separate locations. His embalmed body was laid to rest at mosque in Istanbul and the rest was hidden in a secret location. Now, archaeologists believe they have unearthed the tomb that holds the heart and organs from the great ruler of the Ottoman Empire. 'We have data which all points in the same direction,'said Norbet Pap head of the department of Political Geography, Regional and Development Studies at the University of Pecs in Hungary at a presentation of the latest findings. 'That is why we say 'in all certainty,' because there is no sign pointing in another direction.'
@highlight
Team used historical records and archives to search for location of tomb
@highlight
Decorative elements resemble those where his body is
@highlight
Suleiman's death at Szigetvar was kept secret for 48 days
@highlight
Excavation work at the site would restart in April
Query: Until his death at age 71, Suleiman was the @placeholder's longest-ruling sultan.

Options : A. Suleiman
B. Norbet Pap
C. Szigetvar
D. Regional and Development Studies
E. University of Pecs
F. Istanbul
G. Political Geography
H. Hungary
I. Magnificent
J. Ottoman Empire

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
